Name: Shellfish Produce Pearls
Author: Taelende
Description:
[size=3]In real life, oysters and other shellfish are capable of producing pearls. It's a long process though, but they are of course very valuable and worth it. Even if not for a profit, they're great as gifts! This is a configurable mod that allows for that same functionality in Stardew.

[/size]
[b][color=#e69138][size=5]Config:[/size][/color][/b]
[i](The [code]config.json[/code] will be generated in the mod's folder upon first launch of the game with it installed)[/i]

[code]{
[/code][code]﻿"Clams": "False",
[/code][code][/code][code]﻿﻿"Cockles": "False",[/code][code]
"Mussels": "True",
"Oysters": "True",
"MorePearls": "False",
"FewerPearls": "False"
}

[/code][b]"Clams": [/b]True or False; Sets whether or not Clams are included in the mod's changes. Defaults to [b]False[/b].
[b]"Cockles": [/b]True or False; Sets whether or not Cockles are included in the mod's changes. Defaults to [b]False[/b].
[b]"Mussels": [/b]True or False; Sets whether or not Mussels are included in the mod's changes. Defaults to [b]True[/b].
[b]"Oysters": [/b]True or False; Sets whether or not Oysters are included in the mod's changes. Defaults to [b]True[/b].
[b]"MorePearls": [/b]True or False; Adjusts the drop chances to be weighted more toward Pearls. Defaults to [b]False[/b].
[b]"FewerPearls":[/b] True or False; Adjusts the drop chances to make Pearls rarer. Defaults to [b]False[/b]. 

[color=#e69138][size=5][b]Use:

[/b][/size][/color]Each shellfish pond will only start producing Pearls once it reaches a population of at least 8. They have multiple population gates, so this will take a few days. In the interest of balance, at a population of 8 the chance of them producing any Pearls is still fairly low (5%-8%). Once they reach maximum capacity with a population of 10, these values increase (10%-25%). The configuration value ﻿[code]"MorePearls"[/code] will significantly boost these odds (5%-10% at 8, 10%-50% at 10) when set to [code]True[/code]. With [code]"FewerPearls"[/code], you will be facing slim chances (1%-2% at 8, 2.5%-4% at 10).

Oysters will always be more likely to produce Pearls than the others, and they have a chance to produce up to 3 at a time at a population of 10. 

All screenshots show potential yields with one pond of each type set to [code]True[/code].

[b]!! IF YOU USE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6690?tab=description]SHELL COLLECTION[/url], THE SCALLOPS AND ABALONES ADDED BY THAT MOD WILL ALSO HAVE A CHANCE TO PRODUCE PEARLS !![/b]
